title: Jumpstart's Foster Grandparent Program - Los Angeles City Council Presentation
body: Jumpstart's Foster Grandparent Program - Los Angeles City Council Presentation

segments.text: so here we go right now we're going to
have a special presentation by the great
councilman of the ninth district for
some very special people please welcome
councilman current price famous
president members we have a unique group
with us this morning jumpstart is a
national early childhood organization
working toward the early working toward
the day every child in America enters
kindergarten prepared to succeed the
JumpStart Foster Grandparent program is
a proud member of the federal program
seeing your core which engages adults 55
and older and volunteering 15 to 40
hours a week jumpstart trains community
volunteers by implementing a
research-based curriculum that enables
them to serve preschool aged children in
low-income areas that the work they work
with a team of other volunteers to read
songs play games and foster children's
learning and confidence helping them to
develop the language and literacy skills
that they need to be ready for school
from 2011 to 2014 the jumpstart Foster
Grandparent program has reached more
than 650 children and engage 90 older
adult volunteers throughout the LA area
today in observance of Senior Corps week
we're celebrating the impact of the 55
jumpstart grand parents and the vital
contributions they're providing to our
community let's give them all a warm
welcome please stand
Thank You councilman price and the LA
City Council for having us here today we
know that there's an education crisis
here in Los Angeles and across our
nation children entering kindergarten
not ready to succeed especially in the
communities that need the most support
we also know that older adults are
retiring at record rates sometimes not
having the ability to retire or wanting
to make some use of their free time and
today we have paired both ends of the
spectrum in this program to make a
lasting impact our senior volunteers
here could be at home watching the price
is right and instead they're out there
every day three to five days a week 15
hours or more for a whole school year
helping children succeed the
relationships that they make the bonds
that they make last with these children
for a lifetime and the language and
literacy skills that they provide help
children be prepared for kindergarten
and we know once they enter ready they
have a much higher chance of succeeding
so we thank you for this time to
recognize these amazing senior citizens
who give their wisdom their expertise
and their community and who are giving
back day in and day out to help children
succeed thank you very much
on behalf of a grateful citizenry here
in Los Angeles we want to acknowledge
the Senior Corps program and jumpstart
for its outstanding contributions to our
community thank you very much mr. price
great job give them a better hand
you
